operator: Automated Playwright capture; no human operator
viewport: 393x852 CSS pixels at device scale factor 1
worked_example: Example medication; 10 mg in 1 mL; 50 mL final prepared volume; 2000 mcg ordered dose; expected administration volume 10 mL

captures.title: Blank Mix screen and prototype identity
captures.caption: Initial Mix screen showing the persistent non-clinical warning, v0.1.0 · 6b53fde build identity, manual fields, closed final-volume choices and local-only navigation.

captures.title: Complete inputs with answer hidden
captures.caption: Worked-example inputs are complete, but no administration volume appears before equation review.

captures.title: Mandatory substituted-equation review
captures.caption: The review dialog displays vial, prepared, mg-to-mcg conversion and administration equations; every step must be checked before completion.

captures.title: Result revealed after completed review
captures.caption: After all equations are checked, the prototype reveals 10 mL and requires a separate acknowledgement before history can be saved.

captures.title: External-check acknowledgement
captures.caption: The user acknowledges checking the order, vial unit, ordered-dose unit and final prepared volume; the save action is then enabled.

captures.title: Order above one vial is blocked
captures.caption: An ordered dose greater than the converted amount available in one vial produces a blocking error and no actionable result.

captures.title: Final volume below vial volume is blocked
captures.caption: A 51 mL vial volume with a 50 mL final prepared volume produces a blocking error and no actionable result.

captures.title: Favourite stores vial facts only
captures.caption: Favourites are labelled stored on this device only and retain medication/vial facts without an ordered dose.

captures.title: Saved calculation in local history
captures.caption: Mix history is labelled stored on this device only, warns that it is not a medication order, and displays the source inputs and result.

captures.title: History re-review resets equation checks
captures.caption: Opening a saved mix restores inputs into mandatory equation review with every check reset and the result concealed.

captures.title: Corrupt local storage does not block calculation
captures.caption: A corrupt favourites record disables persistence, displays a recovery warning and leaves the reviewed calculation available.

captures.title: Installed app shell reopened offline
captures.caption: After a successful online app-shell installation and service-worker control, a new page opens offline with the prototype identity and calculator available.
